name: @dsh-toolset/clock-base

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-clock-base && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-clock-base && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-clock-base node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-clock-base tmp/cov-clock-base/report.json
